records.group_key: protected patient crosswalk identity + Phase 2A provider crosswalk identity
records.rule: Group only after both resolve uniquely.
At most one current target representation per patient/provider group.

Select only a unique known-date active-looking, structurally valid, mutually compatible equivalence class at the pinned evaluation coordinate, with a proven Phase 2A target-provider map and newly migrated patient.
No row status/current flag exists; dates alone do not prove eligibility.
Multiple incompatible current-looking classes are conflicting current candidates and are withheld.
Exact duplicates retain all provenance; smallest INS_ID may be deterministic representative only, never evidence of currentness.
No baseline aggregate authorizes row selection; a coordinated protected row snapshot is required.
member_type is not source-evidenced; target default holder must not be applied.
is_active is true only for an approved selected representation; eligibility remains not evidenced.
insurance_tier_id, policy_number, ccc_code, card_holder_insurance_id remain null/not evidenced.
Unknown issue or expiry date is historical-only in Phase 2E; target nullability preserves absence but does not prove currentness.
An explicitly linked pre-existing target patient receives no new membership or insurance child; evidence/provenance only under Phase 2C.
